prompt:
Create unit `tasks` for this task.

Implement `is_month_with_30_days`: `month` is between 1 and 12. Return whether that month has 30 days (April, June, September or November). The contract must state the result exactly.

Required signature (in unit `tasks`):
fn is_month_with_30_days(month: i64) -> (r: bool)

accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(month: i64) -> bool { 1 <= month && month <= 12 }
spec fn ref_post(month: i64, r: bool) -> bool { r == (month == 4 || month == 6 || month == 9 || month == 11) }
